config_unavailable.description: actingd cannot read the metadata of its configuration file: the path given with --config (or the configuration the install selection names) does not exist or cannot be opened. check-config refuses at stage config_load; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
config_unavailable.common_causes: A wrong --config path, a configuration file that was moved or deleted, or a folder the process may not read.
config_unavailable.handling: Pass the path of an existing configuration file, or let acsetup write the configuration again.

config_size_invalid.description: actingd's configuration file is not a regular file, is empty, or is larger than the bound actingd reads. check-config refuses at stage config_load; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
config_size_invalid.common_causes: A truncated or zero-byte file after an interrupted write, a folder given as --config, or a file that is not an actingd configuration.
config_size_invalid.handling: Restore the configuration file (acsetup --commit-config writes it whole) and run actingd check-config again.

install_provider_retired.description: The install selection actingd runs under still names a vision provider file, which the vision root replaced (Workflow #360). check-config refuses at stage config_load; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
install_provider_retired.common_causes: The installation was committed by an acsetup older than the vision root and has not been reconfigured since.
install_provider_retired.handling: Run the current acsetup to commit the configuration again, which writes a selection without the provider file.

maintenance_config_invalid.description: An offline actingd maintenance command (ledger-maintenance) refused its configuration: the schema version is not the one this build reads, the state root is empty, or secret_fingerprint_salt is outside 16 to 1024 bytes.
maintenance_config_invalid.common_causes: A configuration written for another Runtime release, or one edited by hand.
maintenance_config_invalid.handling: Use the configuration of the installed Runtime, or commit it again with acsetup --commit-config, then repeat the maintenance command.

governance_capability_retired.description: actingd's configuration names the retired governance capability member, which this build no longer accepts. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
governance_capability_retired.common_causes: A configuration written for an earlier Runtime release.
governance_capability_retired.handling: Remove the retired member (acsetup --commit-config writes a current configuration) and run actingd check-config again.

vision_provider_manifest_retired.description: actingd's configuration names the retired vision provider manifest, which the vision root replaced (Workflow #360). check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
vision_provider_manifest_retired.common_causes: A configuration written for a Runtime release before the vision root.
vision_provider_manifest_retired.handling: Remove the member and configure the vision section instead; commit the configuration again with acsetup --commit-config.

config_invalid.description: actingd's configuration breaks a top-level rule: schema_version is not the one this build reads, state_root is empty, or secret_fingerprint_salt is outside 16 to 1024 bytes. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
config_invalid.common_causes: A configuration written for another Runtime release, or a hand edit of these members.
config_invalid.handling: Correct the member or let acsetup write a configuration for the installed Runtime, then run actingd check-config again.

bind_host_invalid.description: actingd's configuration member bind_host is not an IP address. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
bind_host_invalid.common_causes: A host name or a typing error in bind_host.
bind_host_invalid.handling: Set bind_host to a loopback IP address such as 127.0.0.1. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

bind_host_not_loopback.description: actingd's configuration member bind_host is an IP address that is not a loopback address; the Runtime listens only on loopback. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
bind_host_not_loopback.common_causes: bind_host set to a LAN or wildcard address to reach the Runtime from another machine.
bind_host_not_loopback.handling: Set bind_host to a loopback address such as 127.0.0.1. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

mumu_root_invalid.description: actingd's configuration member mumu_root is empty or not an absolute path. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
mumu_root_invalid.common_causes: A relative path or an empty string written for the MuMu folder.
mumu_root_invalid.handling: Set mumu_root to the absolute path of the MuMu installation folder, or remove it to let the Runtime find MuMu. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

invalid_pressure_samples.description: A performance pressure streak (performance.monitor.pressure_start_samples or pressure_end_samples) is an integer outside 1 to 30. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
invalid_pressure_samples.common_causes: A value of 0 or a value above 30 written for a streak.
invalid_pressure_samples.handling: Set the streak to a value from 1 to 30, or remove it for the default. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

stuck_recovery_cooldown_invalid.description: An instance's stuck-recovery cool-down (instances[].stuck_recovery_cooldown_secs, or the recovery_ladder value it falls back to) is outside the range the Runtime accepts. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
stuck_recovery_cooldown_invalid.common_causes: A cool-down of 0 or above the upper bound, or a negative value.
stuck_recovery_cooldown_invalid.handling: Set the cool-down within the documented range, or remove it for the recovery_ladder default. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

instance_config_invalid.description: An instances[] entry breaks a rule that needs no discovery: an empty adb_path, host or serial, port 0, a startup_package on a fixture instance, or a device instance without an adb_path outside an install root. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
instance_config_invalid.common_causes: An empty or zero value written for an endpoint member, or an instance copied from another kind of entry.
instance_config_invalid.handling: Correct or remove the member named above in that instance. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

device_path_invalid.description: A device_paths entry (nemu_folder, nemu_ipc_dll, droidcast_apk, minitouch_path or maatouch_path) is empty, not absolute, or names no existing file or folder. Nothing is opened. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
device_path_invalid.common_causes: A relative path, a typing error, or a tool file that was moved, deleted or not installed.
device_path_invalid.handling: Point the entry at an existing absolute path, or remove it to use the default. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

governance_allowed_clients_invalid.description: actingd refused its configuration: governance.allowed_clients is invalid.

vision_config_invalid.description: The vision section breaks its rules: execution_provider cuda without a valid cuda_device, cpu with a cuda_device, or an empty root. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
vision_config_invalid.common_causes: cuda_device left out for cuda, or kept after switching to cpu; root set to an empty string.
vision_config_invalid.handling: Name a cuda_device only with cuda, and give root a path or remove it. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

vision_root_in_program_slot.description: The vision root resolves inside a program slot (A or B) of the install root, which the installer replaces on an upgrade. check-config refuses at stage config_vision; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
vision_root_in_program_slot.common_causes: vision.root pointing into <install root>\A or <install root>\B.
vision_root_in_program_slot.handling: Keep the vision root outside the slots (the default is <install root>\vision). Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

vision_runtime_unavailable.description: The vision root lacks a usable ONNX Runtime: ort\onnxruntime.dll, or for execution_provider cuda the CUDA provider library, is missing or cannot be read. The OS error, when there is one, is the caused_by link. check-config refuses at stage config_vision; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
vision_runtime_unavailable.common_causes: An incomplete vision root (the ort folder not copied), cuda configured with a CPU-only runtime, or files removed by antivirus.
vision_runtime_unavailable.handling: Restore the ort folder of the vision root (the installer places it), or switch execution_provider to cpu, then run actingd check-config again.

catalog_transition_kind_unknown.description: policy.catalog_transition names a kind other than replace, the only transition kind. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
catalog_transition_kind_unknown.common_causes: A typing error in kind, or a transition written for another release.
catalog_transition_kind_unknown.handling: Set kind to replace, or remove policy.catalog_transition for the forward-only rule. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

catalog_transition_invalid.description: policy.catalog_transition's expected_active_catalog_hash is not sha256: followed by 64 lowercase hex digits. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
catalog_transition_invalid.common_causes: A hash copied without its sha256: prefix, in upper case, or cut short.
catalog_transition_invalid.handling: Copy the active catalog hash as check-config's policy_plan reports it. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

startup_package_path_invalid.description: actingd refused its configuration: a startup package path is not absolute.

startup_package_invalid.description: actingd refused its configuration: a startup package request is invalid.

resource_package_missing.description: An instance's resource_package path does not exist (alias names the instance, path the resolved path). check-config refuses at stage config_resource_package; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
resource_package_missing.common_causes: A relative path resolved against the wrong folder, an empty path, or a package folder that was moved or not yet placed.
resource_package_missing.handling: Place the resource package at the path, or correct instances[].resource_package. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

resource_package_invalid.description: An instance's resource_package exists but the contained-task package loader refuses it, as task-run would (alias names the instance, path the package); the loader's refusal is the caused_by link. check-config refuses at stage config_resource_package; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
resource_package_invalid.common_causes: A package built for another package format, an incomplete copy, or a path that is neither a file nor a folder.
resource_package_invalid.handling: Replace the package with a complete one from its resource release, or point resource_package at the right package. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

procedure_manifest_size_invalid.description: actingd refused its configuration: the procedure manifest is empty or too large.

procedure_task_duplicate.description: actingd refused its configuration: a scheduled procedure is bound twice.

procedure_manifest_invalid.description: actingd refused its configuration: the procedure manifest is invalid.

procedure_binding_size_invalid.description: actingd refused its configuration: a procedure binding names too many yield points.

procedure_binding_invalid.description: actingd refused its configuration: a procedure binding is invalid.

procedure_package_path_missing.description: actingd refused its configuration: a scheduled procedure names no package path.

procedure_package_unavailable.description: actingd refused its configuration: a procedure package path is unavailable.

procedure_package_not_regular.description: actingd refused its configuration: a procedure package is not of the kind its reference names.

procedure_package_container_unsupported.description: actingd refused its configuration: a procedure package container file is not supported.

procedure_task_request_invalid.description: actingd refused its configuration: a scheduled procedure request is invalid.

policy_catalog_approval_mismatch.description: policy.catalog_approval_ids is empty, too long, holds duplicates, differs from the approval references the policy catalog documents name, or holds an id the approval record does not accept. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
policy_catalog_approval_mismatch.common_causes: The catalog documents were updated without updating catalog_approval_ids, or an id was typed by hand.
policy_catalog_approval_mismatch.handling: Set catalog_approval_ids to exactly the approval references of the catalog in use. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

policy_catalog_size_invalid.description: The four policy catalog documents (tasks, pools, activity, timeline) are larger together than the bound actingd reads. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
policy_catalog_size_invalid.common_causes: A catalog generated with far more entries than intended, or a wrong file named as a catalog document.
policy_catalog_size_invalid.handling: Check that policy.catalog names the intended documents and reduce the catalog. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

policy_catalog_path_invalid.description: A policy.catalog document path (tasks, pools, activity or timeline) is empty. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
policy_catalog_path_invalid.common_causes: A catalog member left empty when the configuration was written.
policy_catalog_path_invalid.handling: Name each catalog document's path. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

policy_catalog_document_size_invalid.description: A policy catalog document is not a regular file, is empty, or is larger than the per-document bound. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
policy_catalog_document_size_invalid.common_causes: A folder named as a document, a truncated or zero-byte file, or a wrong file.
policy_catalog_document_size_invalid.handling: Restore the document from the catalog's release and check the path. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

policy_catalog_read_failed.description: Reading a policy catalog document failed after its metadata was read. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
policy_catalog_read_failed.common_causes: The file is locked or removed by another program, or the folder may not be read by the process.
policy_catalog_read_failed.handling: Make the document readable to the Runtime's user and run actingd check-config again.

policy_instance_set_mismatch.description: The instances the policy facts declare differ from the aliases of the configured instances. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
policy_instance_set_mismatch.common_causes: An instance added to or removed from instances[] without the same change in the policy facts, or an alias renamed on one side only.
policy_instance_set_mismatch.handling: Make the policy instance ids and the instance aliases the same set. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

policy_instance_host_unknown.description: A policy instance names a host_id that policy.resources.hosts does not list. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
policy_instance_host_unknown.common_causes: A host renamed or removed in policy.resources without updating the instances.
policy_instance_host_unknown.handling: Add the host to policy.resources.hosts or correct the instance's host_id. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

scheduled_execution_binding_missing.description: actingd refused its configuration: a scheduled task has no execution binding.

scheduled_execution_instance_unknown.description: actingd refused a scheduled execution: its instance is not configured.

scheduled_execution_backend_mode_mismatc.description: actingd refused a scheduled execution: the instance's backend mode differs from the binding's.

scheduled_execution_backend_mode_unavail.description: actingd refused its configuration: no instance offers a scheduled binding's backend mode.

instance_binding_key_invalid.description: An instance's discovery binding key is invalid: both instance_index and instance_name are set, instance_name is blank, too long or holds a control character, or a discovery-bound instance also names a serial. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
instance_binding_key_invalid.common_causes: Both binding keys written for one instance, or a serial kept from an explicit entry.
instance_binding_key_invalid.handling: Bind the instance by exactly one of instance_index or instance_name, and drop serial. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

application_identity_missing.description: A device instance names no application_id, or only blanks. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
application_identity_missing.common_causes: application_id left out when the instance was added.
application_identity_missing.handling: Set the instance's application_id. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

touch_backend_invalid.description: A device instance's touch_backend is missing or not a backend name the Runtime knows. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
touch_backend_invalid.common_causes: touch_backend left out, or a typing error in its value.
touch_backend_invalid.handling: Set touch_backend to one of the documented backends. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

capture_backend_invalid.description: A device instance's capture_backend is missing or not a backend name the Runtime knows. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
capture_backend_invalid.common_causes: capture_backend left out, or a typing error in its value.
capture_backend_invalid.handling: Set capture_backend to one of the documented backends. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

touch_backend_must_be_explicit.description: A device instance's touch_backend is an automatic choice (auto or auto_fastest), which the daemon does not accept. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
touch_backend_must_be_explicit.common_causes: A configuration that relied on automatic touch selection.
touch_backend_must_be_explicit.handling: Name the touch backend explicitly. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

capture_backend_must_be_explicit.description: A device instance's capture_backend is an automatic choice (auto or auto_fastest), which the daemon does not accept. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
capture_backend_must_be_explicit.common_causes: A configuration that relied on automatic capture selection.
capture_backend_must_be_explicit.handling: Name the capture backend explicitly. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

nemu_app_index_invalid.description: A device instance that pairs Nemu touch with Nemu capture names a nemu_app_index outside the range the Nemu input accepts. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
nemu_app_index_invalid.common_causes: A negative index or one copied from another tool's numbering.
nemu_app_index_invalid.handling: Set nemu_app_index to a valid index. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

nemu_paired_input_configuration_missing.description: A device instance selects Nemu touch without Nemu capture or without nemu_app_index; Nemu touch works only paired with Nemu capture. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
nemu_paired_input_configuration_missing.common_causes: touch_backend switched to Nemu while capture_backend stayed another backend, or nemu_app_index left out.
nemu_paired_input_configuration_missing.handling: Use Nemu capture and set nemu_app_index together with Nemu touch, or choose another touch backend. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

instance_registration_invalid.description: The execution backend registration of a device instance refused its declaration: the alias, instance id, application identity, touch or capture settings, nemu_app_index pairing or handset binding breaks a registration rule. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
instance_registration_invalid.common_causes: An alias or instance_id that breaks the identifier rules, or a backend combination the registration does not allow.
instance_registration_invalid.handling: Correct the instance's identifiers and backend members. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

fixture_device_fields_forbidden.description: A fixture (simulation) instance names a member only a device instance may have, such as application_id, an endpoint, a binding key, a backend or a timeout. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
fixture_device_fields_forbidden.common_causes: A device instance turned into a fixture without removing its device members.
fixture_device_fields_forbidden.handling: Remove the device members from the fixture instance. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

fixture_backend_missing.description: An instance is treated as a fixture but has no fixture_backend member. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
fixture_backend_missing.common_causes: A fixture instance whose fixture_backend was left out.
fixture_backend_missing.handling: Add the fixture_backend member, or make the instance a device instance. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

fixture_backend_invalid.description: A fixture instance's fixture_backend breaks its rules: the alias is invalid, it lists no frame or too many, or max_inputs is above its bound. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
fixture_backend_invalid.common_causes: An empty frame list or limits copied from another test setup.
fixture_backend_invalid.handling: Correct the fixture_backend members. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

fixture_frame_size_invalid.description: A fixture frame's width and height give no valid RGB size, exceed the per-frame bound, or do not match the length of its pixel data. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
fixture_frame_size_invalid.common_causes: A frame whose pixel data was cut or generated for another size.
fixture_frame_size_invalid.handling: Regenerate the frame with matching width, height and RGB data. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

fixture_resident_size_invalid.description: The fixture frames of one instance are larger together than the resident bound. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
fixture_resident_size_invalid.common_causes: Too many or too large fixture frames for one instance.
fixture_resident_size_invalid.handling: Use fewer or smaller fixture frames. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

fixture_frame_invalid.description: A fixture frame of a valid size cannot be built into a frame. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
fixture_frame_invalid.common_causes: Pixel data that the frame builder refuses.
fixture_frame_invalid.handling: Regenerate the fixture frame. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

timeout_invalid.description: A device instance's timeout (command_timeout_ms, handshake_timeout_ms, shutdown_timeout_ms or tap_hold_ms) is 0 or above its upper bound. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
timeout_invalid.common_causes: A timeout written in seconds instead of milliseconds, or set to 0.
timeout_invalid.handling: Set the timeout in milliseconds within the bound, or remove it for the default. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

config_manifest_incomplete.description: check-config could not report a value its report must carry from the configuration manifest (a performance pressure streak or a device path entry is missing or of another type). check-config refuses at stage config_assemble.
config_manifest_incomplete.common_causes: A defect: the manifest the assembly built lacks a row the report reads.
config_manifest_incomplete.handling: Report it with the configuration and the build; the configuration itself may be valid.

config_manifest_invalid.description: actingd could not build its configuration manifest: a value the configuration mechanism resolved has another type than the assembly expects, or a member could not be serialised. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
config_manifest_invalid.common_causes: A defect in the assembly or the configuration mechanism.
config_manifest_invalid.handling: Report it with the configuration and the build.

config_manifest_value_out_of_range.description: actingd could not put a configured integer or duration into its configuration manifest, because it does not fit the manifest's value range. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
config_manifest_value_out_of_range.common_causes: A configured value far outside any sensible range that no earlier check refused.
config_manifest_value_out_of_range.handling: Use a value within the documented range. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

env_override_ignored.description: An ACTINGCOMMAND_* environment variable (variable names it) is set but not read, because allow_env_overrides is off. check-config reports it as a note link of check_config_passed; the start goes on without it.
env_override_ignored.common_causes: A variable left in the user's or the launcher's environment from earlier tests.
env_override_ignored.handling: Remove the variable, or set allow_env_overrides to true when the override is intended.

adb_install_missing.description: actingd refused the install root's adb (Workflow #337): a distributed platform-tools binary under <install root>\tools\platform-tools is missing or cannot be read. adb_path names the adb, aliases the instances that use it, tools_dir the tools folder and files each finding. A damaged installation, so fatal: check-config refuses at stage config_assemble, a start refuses before the ledger opens and the watchdog holds.
adb_install_missing.common_causes: Files removed by antivirus or by hand, or an incomplete installation.
adb_install_missing.handling: Reinstall tools\platform-tools under the install root with acsetup, or set the instances' adb_path to another adb, then start again.

adb_install_mismatch.description: actingd refused the install root's adb (Workflow #337): a distributed platform-tools binary under <install root>\tools\platform-tools differs from the SHA-256 this build pins. adb_path names the adb, aliases the instances that use it, tools_dir the tools folder and files each finding. A damaged installation, so fatal: check-config refuses at stage config_assemble, a start refuses before the ledger opens and the watchdog holds.
adb_install_mismatch.common_causes: platform-tools replaced by another adb version, or files changed after installation.
adb_install_mismatch.handling: Reinstall tools\platform-tools under the install root with acsetup, or set the instances' adb_path to another adb, then start again.

adb_install_pin_invalid.description: The platform-tools pin this build carries (scripts/windows-tools/windows-tool-sources.v1.json, compiled in) cannot be used: it does not decode (the decoder's text is a foreign_data_error link) or does not list the adb among its distributed files. A build defect, so fatal.
adb_install_pin_invalid.common_causes: A release built with a broken or incomplete pin file.
adb_install_pin_invalid.handling: Install a release whose pin is intact; report the build.

emulator_capability_admission_refused.description: Provider startup refused the emulator capability profile built from MuMuManager discovery: the inventory or status read the Runtime needs is not available. mumu_manager_version is the version discovery reported and mumu_root the configured MuMu folder; the capability admission's refusal is the caused_by link. The start fails.
emulator_capability_admission_refused.common_causes: A MuMuManager release whose discovery report lacks a capability the Runtime requires.
emulator_capability_admission_refused.handling: Install a MuMu release the Runtime supports, then start again.

instance_discovery_no_match.description: Provider startup found no discovered emulator instance for an instance's binding key: alias names the configured instance and instance_index or instance_name its declared key. The start fails.
instance_discovery_no_match.common_causes: An instance index or name that does not exist in MuMu, or an instance renamed or deleted in MuMu.
instance_discovery_no_match.handling: Correct the instance's instance_index or instance_name to a discovered instance (actingctl emulator discover lists them). Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

instance_discovery_ambiguous.description: Provider startup found more than one discovered emulator instance with the declared instance_name: alias names the configured instance, instance_name the key and instances the candidates. The start fails.
instance_discovery_ambiguous.common_causes: Two MuMu instances with the same name.
instance_discovery_ambiguous.handling: Rename one instance in MuMu, or bind by instance_index instead. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

instance_discovery_conflict.description: Provider startup failed because a declared endpoint value of a discovery-bound instance disagrees with what discovery reported; the recorded failure is adb_path_conflict, host_conflict, port_conflict or port_unverifiable with the declared and discovered values. The start fails.
instance_discovery_conflict.common_causes: A declared adb_path, host or port left over from an explicit entry, or a port declared for a stopped instance.
instance_discovery_conflict.handling: Remove the declared adb_path, host and port of the discovery-bound instance, or make them match discovery. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

vision_provider_unavailable.description: Provider startup could not build the vision provider from the models the vision root lists; the vision provider's refusal is the caused_by link (relayed). The start fails.
vision_provider_unavailable.common_causes: A model folder whose files the provider cannot use, or a runtime library that does not load.
vision_provider_unavailable.handling: Run actingd check-config to list the vision root, repair or remove the model folder, then start again.

vision_provider_path_encoding_invalid.description: Provider startup refused a vision path (the root, a model or runtime file) that is not valid UTF-8 before recording it; the recorded failure is path_encoding_invalid. The start fails.
vision_provider_path_encoding_invalid.common_causes: A vision root under a folder whose name is not representable as UTF-8.
vision_provider_path_encoding_invalid.handling: Move the vision root to a folder with a plain name and set vision.root accordingly. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

adb_path_conflict.description: The failure provider startup records under instance_discovery_conflict when a discovery-bound instance's declared adb_path is not the adb MuMu reports for it: alias names the instance, adb_path the declared adb, other_path the discovered adb and instances what discovery reported.
adb_path_conflict.common_causes: An adb_path pointing at another MuMu installation or another adb.
adb_path_conflict.handling: Remove adb_path (the discovered or the install root's adb is used) or set it to the discovered adb. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

host_conflict.description: The failure provider startup records under instance_discovery_conflict when a discovery-bound instance's declared host differs from the host discovery reports: alias names the instance, adb_host the declared host and instances what discovery reported.
host_conflict.common_causes: A host kept from an explicit entry or from another machine's configuration.
host_conflict.handling: Remove host from the discovery-bound instance or set it to the discovered host. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

port_conflict.description: The failure provider startup records under instance_discovery_conflict when a discovery-bound instance's declared port differs from the port discovery reports: alias names the instance, adb_port the declared port and instances what discovery reported.
port_conflict.common_causes: A port kept from an explicit entry, or a MuMu instance whose port changed.
port_conflict.handling: Remove port from the discovery-bound instance (discovery supplies it) or set it to the discovered port. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

port_unverifiable.description: The failure provider startup records under instance_discovery_conflict when a discovery-bound instance declares a port but its instance is stopped, so discovery reports no port to check it against: alias names the instance, adb_port the declared port and instances what discovery reported (running false).
port_unverifiable.common_causes: A port declared for an instance that was not running at the start.
port_unverifiable.handling: Remove port from the discovery-bound instance (it is then bound pending until started), or start the instance first.

adb_path_encoding_invalid.description: The failure provider startup records when the adb path MuMu reports for a discovery-bound instance is not valid UTF-8: alias names the instance, other_path the discovered adb (converted lossily), adb_path the declared adb when there is one and instances what discovery reported. The start fails as instance_discovery_unavailable.
adb_path_encoding_invalid.common_causes: MuMu installed under a folder whose name is not representable as UTF-8.
adb_path_encoding_invalid.handling: Install MuMu under a folder with a plain name, or bind the instance to the install root's adb by leaving adb_path out.

path_encoding_invalid.description: The failure provider startup records under vision_provider_path_encoding_invalid: a vision path is not valid UTF-8.
path_encoding_invalid.common_causes: A vision root under a folder whose name is not representable as UTF-8.
path_encoding_invalid.handling: Move the vision root to a folder with a plain name and set vision.root accordingly.

check_config_usage_invalid.description: actingd check-config was given more arguments than --config <path>. The report carries this outcome; exit 1.
check_config_usage_invalid.common_causes: A caller that passes extra arguments.

check_config_option_invalid.description: actingd check-config was given an option other than --config, --config twice, an empty value, or a dangling argument. The report carries this outcome; exit 1.
check_config_option_invalid.common_causes: A misspelt option or a missing value.

check_config_config_missing.description: actingd check-config was given no --config. The report carries this outcome; exit 1.
check_config_config_missing.common_causes: A caller that omits the configuration path.

check_config_report_encode_failed.description: actingd check-config could not encode its report as JSON; the report line then carries only this outcome; exit 1.
check_config_report_encode_failed.common_causes: A defect in the report's construction.
check_config_report_encode_failed.handling: Report it with the configuration and the build.

maintenance_usage_invalid.description: actingd ledger-maintenance was given fewer or more arguments than an operation with its options allows. The report carries this outcome; exit 1.
maintenance_usage_invalid.common_causes: A caller that omits the operation or passes extra arguments.
maintenance_usage_invalid.handling: Run actingd ledger-maintenance <dry-run|import|verify|backup|restore> --config <path> with the operation's options.

maintenance_operation_invalid.description: actingd ledger-maintenance was given an operation other than dry-run, import, verify, backup or restore. The report carries this outcome; exit 1.
maintenance_operation_invalid.handling: Name one of the five operations.

maintenance_option_invalid.description: actingd ledger-maintenance was given an option other than --config, --backup, --target or --artifact-root, an option twice, an empty value, or a dangling argument. The report carries this outcome; exit 1.
maintenance_option_invalid.common_causes: A misspelt option or a missing value.
maintenance_option_invalid.handling: Correct the options of the maintenance command.

maintenance_config_missing.description: actingd ledger-maintenance was given no --config. The report carries this outcome; exit 1.
maintenance_config_missing.common_causes: A caller that omits the configuration path.

maintenance_receipt_encode_failed.description: actingd ledger-maintenance could not encode its receipt as JSON; the report line then carries only this outcome; exit 1.
maintenance_receipt_encode_failed.common_causes: A defect in the receipt's construction.
maintenance_receipt_encode_failed.handling: Report it with the build; run the maintenance again only after checking the ledger with verify.

ledger_maintenance_failed.description: The code of actingd's error for a ledger-maintenance run that failed. It is never emitted on its own: the subcommand's report, its developer line and its exit carry the maintenance failure's own outcome (its own code, with its stage and values), so this code reaches no interface and no ledger record.
ledger_maintenance_failed.common_causes: The maintenance failure the report names.
ledger_maintenance_failed.handling: Follow the handling of the code the report names.

runtime_ready.description: The Runtime started and is ready to answer requests: actingd's daemon line, with pid its process id. It follows the start's ledger_opened, owner_released and scheduling pause lines.

runtime_stopped.description: The Runtime stopped. On a requested stop (a shutdown request, an accepted held-start shutdown) it is the terminal outcome; when a condition stopped the Runtime, that condition follows it as the last daemon line and is the terminal outcome.
runtime_stopped.common_causes: A shutdown request, or a condition that stopped the Runtime.
runtime_stopped.handling: None on a requested stop; otherwise handle the condition on the last line.

actingd_fallback_log_failed.description: A start refusal could not be appended to the fallback log %LOCALAPPDATA%\ActingCommand\logs: path names the folder or file, variable is set when LOCALAPPDATA is not. Only a developer line; the refusal itself is still on stderr.
actingd_fallback_log_failed.common_causes: LOCALAPPDATA not set for the starting user, or a logs folder that cannot be created or written.
actingd_fallback_log_failed.handling: Start actingd with stderr redirected to a file, or make the logs folder writable.

check_config_passed.description: actingd check-config passed (check-config v2): the configuration loads, assembles and validates as a start would, and the catalog plan was previewed from the ledger read-only. report holds the details; what the check noted (an ignored environment override, the MuMu resolution, an unused device binding, a broken standard-pack root, a missing fact reader) is a note link.
check_config_passed.handling: None; read the note links before committing or starting.

ledger_maintenance_completed.description: An actingd ledger-maintenance pass completed: the report holds the receipt, whose status names the operation's result (for verify, which ledger was verified).
ledger_maintenance_completed.common_causes: The maintenance operation did what was asked.

unlock_owner_completed.description: actingd unlock-owner recorded the operator's confirmation (Workflow #378 A6a).

suspended_reported.description: actingd suspended produced its report (Workflow #378 A6a).

unlock_owner_usage_invalid.description: actingd unlock-owner was given too many arguments.

unlock_owner_option_invalid.description: actingd unlock-owner was given an unknown, repeated or empty option.

unlock_owner_actor_invalid.description: actingd unlock-owner was given an invalid --actor.

unlock_owner_report_encode_failed.description: actingd unlock-owner could not encode its report.

suspended_usage_invalid.description: actingd suspended was given too many arguments.

suspended_option_invalid.description: actingd suspended was given an unknown, repeated or empty option.

suspended_report_encode_failed.description: actingd suspended could not encode its report.

install_held_input_invalid.description: actingd refused its --install-held input: it is longer than 4096 bytes, not UTF-8, or not the held startup's JSON. A start refusal before the ledger opens; exit 1.
install_held_input_invalid.common_causes: An installer of another release that writes a different held-start shape, or an argument cut or mangled by a launcher.
install_held_input_invalid.handling: Start the held Runtime with the installer that matches this release.

usage_invalid.description: actingd was started without exactly --config <path> (or --config <path> --install-held <json>). The daemon line is a start refusal; exit 1.
usage_invalid.common_causes: A launcher or script that passes other arguments, an empty path, or an unknown subcommand name.
usage_invalid.handling: Start actingd as actingd --config <path to actingd.config.json>.

policy_bootstrap_state_invalid.description: actingd's policy bootstrap and its first cycle disagree.

policy_catalog_plan_changed.description: The activated catalog generation differs from the planned one.

policy_pending_dispatch_budget_exceeded.description: A policy cycle holds more pending dispatch intents than its bound.

policy_pending_dispatch_without_evaluati.description: A policy cycle holds pending dispatch intents but no evaluation.

policy_cycle_yield_report_failed.description: actingd could not write the line of a policy cycle that reached its budget.

policy_recompute_wake_budget_exceeded.description: A policy cycle produced more recompute wakes than its bound.

policy_recompute_terminal_missing.description: A scheduled run's receipt carries no terminal event for its recompute wake.

policy_recompute_wake_identity_conflict.description: A recompute wake's identity differs from its run's.

policy_subscription_cursor_invalid.description: The policy monitor's first event page request is invalid.

policy_driver_spawn_failed.description: actingd could not start its policy driver thread.

policy_driver_stopped.description: actingd's policy driver thread ended while the monitor ran.

policy_subscription_request_invalid.description: The policy monitor's subscription request is invalid.

policy_driver_reference_leaked.description: A reference to the Runtime host outlived the policy driver at close.

policy_driver_signal_poisoned.description: The policy driver's signal lock is poisoned.

policy_driver_wake_missing.description: The policy driver woke without work.

policy_recompute_trigger_missing.description: The policy driver took recompute work without its trigger.

policy_monitor_request_retried.description: A request of actingd's policy monitor to its own Runtime got no receipt header within policy.monitor.io_timeout_ms (io_kind timed_out, or would_block); the monitor sends it again on a fresh connection after retry_after_ms. attempts counts the failures in a row, limit_count is policy.monitor.retry_limit.
policy_monitor_request_retried.common_causes: The host is overloaded (CPU near 100 %) or the Runtime's ledger writer stalls longer than the monitor's I/O timeout.
policy_monitor_request_retried.handling: None while the failures stay under the limit. If it recurs, lower the host load or raise policy.monitor.io_timeout_ms.

policy_monitor_retries_exhausted.description: actingd's policy monitor gave up: after limit_count retries in a row (policy.monitor.retry_limit), one more request to its own Runtime got no receipt header in time. actingd then stops with that request's failure.
policy_monitor_retries_exhausted.common_causes: The Runtime did not answer its local IPC for longer than the retries cover: a sustained host overload, or a Runtime that hangs.
policy_monitor_retries_exhausted.handling: Check the host load and the Runtime's ledger writer, then start the Runtime again. If the host is expected to stall this long, raise policy.monitor.retry_limit, retry_backoff_max_ms or io_timeout_ms.

policy_monitor_runtime_identity_changed.description: The policy monitor's connection reached a Runtime other than the one actingd hosts: the Runtime info file names another owner epoch or process id. actingd stops.

policy_monitor_config_invalid.description: A policy.monitor value is outside its range: io_timeout_ms outside 1000 to 60000, retry_limit above 100, retry_backoff_ms outside 1 to 600000, or retry_backoff_max_ms below retry_backoff_ms or above 600000. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
policy_monitor_config_invalid.common_causes: A value written in seconds instead of milliseconds, or a maximum backoff below the backoff.
policy_monitor_config_invalid.handling: Set the policy.monitor values within their ranges, or remove them for the defaults. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

provider_native_failed.description: Provider startup failed in the device layer with a failure that names no registered code of its own (no MuMu resolution reason): device_category names the device failure's category when it has one and mumu_root the configured MuMu folder; the device's own text is a foreign_other_error link. check-config reports the same outcome as a note when the MuMu folder cannot be resolved.
provider_native_failed.common_causes: MuMuManager failing or timing out, an unreadable MuMu folder, or an OS error during discovery.
provider_native_failed.handling: Check that MuMu is installed and MuMuManager runs, set mumu_root when MuMu is not found, then start again; report it when it repeats.

config_subsystem_configured.description: The configuration manifest reports a subsystem the configuration file configures: its flag is on or its section is present.

config_subsystem_configured_off.description: The configuration manifest reports a subsystem the configuration file turns off with its flag; an env_overrides subsystem carries each ignored ACTINGCOMMAND_* variable as a note link of env_override_ignored.

config_subsystem_flag_absent.description: The configuration manifest reports a subsystem whose flag the configuration file does not name, so its default applies; an env_overrides subsystem carries each ignored ACTINGCOMMAND_* variable as a note link of env_override_ignored.

config_subsystem_section_absent.description: The configuration manifest reports a subsystem off because the configuration file has no section for it.

config_subsystem_always_on.description: The configuration manifest reports a subsystem the Runtime always runs; count is the number of allowed client identities when the governance subsystem restricts them.

config_subsystem_discovery_bound.description: The configuration manifest reports a discovery subsystem on: count instances are bound by instance_index or instance_name.

config_subsystem_discovery_unbound.description: The configuration manifest reports a discovery subsystem off: no instance is bound by instance_index or instance_name.

device_config_invalid.description: An instance's device fields do not fit its device kind (#398 R1): for example a handset that names an endpoint, a serial or a discovery key, or selects a capture backend only emulators have, or an emulator that names scrcpy capture. alias names the instance and device_config_problem the rule. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
device_config_invalid.common_causes: An emulator entry copied for a handset, or a backend chosen that the device kind does not have.
device_config_invalid.handling: Correct the instance as device_config_problem says. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

device_binding_missing.description: The private binding file <state root>\private\device-bindings.json binds no device to a handset instance (alias names it, #398 R1 RD-1b). check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start registers the instance unavailable and goes on.
device_binding_missing.common_causes: A handset instance added before its device was bound, or a binding removed.
device_binding_missing.handling: Bind a discovered device to the instance through the console or the CLI, then run actingd check-config again.

device_binding_file_invalid.description: actingd refused the private binding file <state root>\private\device-bindings.json (#398 R1 RD-1b): it cannot be read, breaks its shape or schema, or binds an alias or a device twice. path names the file and device_binding_problem the rule. check-config and a start refuse before the ledger opens.
device_binding_file_invalid.common_causes: A hand edit of the private file, a file written by another release, or a file another program holds open.
device_binding_file_invalid.handling: Repair or remove the binding file and bind the devices again through the console or the CLI.

device_binding_unused.description: The private binding file binds an alias (alias names it) that no handset instance of the configuration has (#398 R1 RD-1b). check-config reports it as a note link of check_config_passed; nothing is refused.
device_binding_unused.common_causes: A handset instance renamed or removed while its binding stayed.
device_binding_unused.handling: Remove the stale binding, or add the handset instance it was meant for.

start_emulator_requires_discovery_bindin.description: An instance names start_emulator true but has no emulator the daemon can start (Workflow #369 S6a): it is a fixture, or it is not bound by instance_index or instance_name. alias names the instance. check-config refuses at stage config_assemble; a start refuses before the ledger opens.
start_emulator_requires_discovery_bindin.common_causes: start_emulator set on an explicit or fixture instance.
start_emulator_requires_discovery_bindin.handling: Bind the instance by instance_index or instance_name, or remove start_emulator. Fix the configuration and commit it again with acsetup --commit-config; run actingd check-config to confirm before restarting the daemon.

config_load.description: The stage of a check-config refusal (and an unlock-owner failure) that arose while loading the configuration file and the installation it runs under (was the v1 stage token load).

config_assemble.description: The stage of a check-config refusal that arose while assembling the configuration: its members, instances, device bindings, the install root's adb and the configuration manifest (was the v1 stage token assemble).

config_vision.description: The stage of a check-config refusal that arose while listing the vision root (was the v1 stage token vision).

config_validate.description: The stage of a check-config refusal that arose while validating the assembled host configuration (was the v1 stage token validate).

resource_package.description: Retired (Workflow #378 A6a): renamed config_resource_package, as resource_package is the check-config report's member name.

config_resource_package.description: The stage of a check-config refusal that arose while admitting the instances' resource packages (Workflow #378 A6a; was resource_package).

config_recognition_binding.description: The stage of a check-config refusal that arose while checking the instances' recognition package bindings (Workflow #384 D2-S2).

policy_state.description: The stage of a check-config refusal that arose while previewing the catalog plan against the ledger, read-only.

policy_initialization.description: actingd stage: activating the configured catalog and running the first policy cycle.

policy_bootstrap.description: actingd stage: choosing between the policy driver and the plain monitor.

policy_monitor_setup.description: actingd stage: connecting the policy monitor and starting the policy driver.

policy_closeout_driver.description: actingd stage of the policy closeout: the policy driver's result (FATAL token driver).

policy_closeout_monitor.description: actingd stage of the policy closeout: the policy monitor's result (FATAL token monitor).

policy_closeout_shutdown.description: actingd stage of the policy closeout: the policy driver's shutdown (FATAL token shutdown).

policy_closeout_host_close.description: actingd stage of the policy closeout: closing the Runtime host (FATAL token close).
